images.filename: 1973 AMC Hornet X with Levis option at AMO 2015 meet-1of4.jpg
images.caption: 1973 AMC Hornet X, a sporty compact-sized hatchback made by American Motors Corporation. This Pewter Silver (paint code E5) car has the optional Levis interior. Real denim was not used because it was not tough enough to serve as automobile upholstery. AMC turned to spun nylon that looked like the genuine article, as well as copper Levis rivets, traditional contrasting stitching, and even the Levi’s tab on both the front seat backs. The option also included unique door panels with Levis trim and removable map pockets, as well as Levis decals on the front fenders. The X package included coordinated "rally" side stripes, 14 x 6-inch slot-style steel wheels with C78 x 14 Polyglas blackball tires, an "X" emblem, and a sports steering wheel. Picture taken at the American Motors Owners Association (AMO) annual convention that was held July 2015 near Cleveland, Ohio.

images.filename: 1974 AMC Gremlin X and Levi's package in Diamond blue at 2021 AMO 6of6.jpg
images.caption:
1974 AMC Gremlin, an economical and sporty subcompact automobile made by American Motors Corporation (AMC). This car has the popular "X package" along with the optional Levi's "designer" interior. It is finished in Diamond Blue metallic paint (made the car glow almost like a blue diamond!) that was exclusive for AMC's small cars.
Photographs were taken during the June 2021 American Motors Owners (AMO) convention that was held in Colorado Springs, Colorado.

images.filename: 1973 AMC Gremlin X and Levi's package finished in Maxi Blue with white stripes at 2017 AMO meet 5of5.jpg
images.caption: 1973 AMC Gremlin X with the Levi’s interior trim option finished in Maxi Blue with white stripes. A sporty subcompact car built by American Motors Corporation (AMC). The optional interior features spun nylon that looked like demin, as well as copper Levis rivets, traditional contrasting stitching, and even the Levi’s tab on both the front seat backs. The option also included unique door panels with Levis trim and removable map pockets, as well as Levis decals on the front fenders.  The X package includes: slot-style 14x6-inch road wheels, D70x14 white letter tires, sport steering wheel, custom interior package with bucket seats, interior appointment package, cargo area insulation and carpet, as well as body side stripes, rear panel, and body painted grille with accent stripe. Photographs were taken during the 2017 American Motors Owners (AMO) convention that was held in Gettysburg, Pennsylvania. This show was organized by the Potomac Ramblers Automobile Club.

images.filename: 1973 AMC Gremlin Levi's blue X at 2024 AMO meet 4of6.jpg
images.caption:
1973 AMC Gremlin X - with the optional Levi's trim package finished in "Maxi Blue" paint code F3. This is a sub-compact car built by American Motors Corporation. This car has the 258 cid (4.2 L) straight-six engine with automatic transmission and factory air conditioning, power steering, power brakes, and AM radio.
The picture was taken during the American Motors Owners Association (AMO) annual convention in June 2024, organized by the Potomac Ramblers Club at the Keystone Truck and Tractor Museum in Petersburg, Virginia.

images.caption:
Levi Strauss & Co. began in 1853 in San Francisco, California.
One of Levi's customers, Jacob Davis, in 1871 invented a way to strengthen work pants using rivets.  Davis went into business with Levi to mass produce riveted work pants.

-- Lynn Downey,
